source.manualTitle: Samsung NE58F9710WS Flex Duo Electric Range (FER710DRS)
source.oemTestTitle: Ceramic cooktop radiant elements — knob control

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect electrical power at breaker before servicing. Replace all panels before operating. 240 VAC present at terminal block when energized.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing the range. Replace all panels before operating range.

steps.title: Access surface harness
steps.body: Disconnect power. Remove ceramic glass cooktop per §3-5. Inspect radiant element harness connectors.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Remove ceramic glass cooktop per §3-5. Inspect radiant element harness connectors.

steps.title: Radiant element / infinite switch
steps.body: Verify knob-controlled infinite switch sends power to radiant element. Measure element continuity at terminals.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify knob-controlled infinite switch sends power to radiant element. Measure element continuity at terminals.

steps.title: Replace surface element or switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace radiant element or infinite switch — platform implementation.

steps.title: Surface heat path OK
steps.oemOutcome: Surface heating path verified at platform level.
